visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short hair and glasses, wearing a black button-down shirt, stands in a brightly lit studio. Behind him is a blurred background of a white table set with several bowls of noodles and side dishes. He holds a small black remote control in his right hand and gestures expressively with his left hand while looking directly at the camera. (2) The visual cuts to a digital screenshot of a research paper titled 'Synthetic afterlives: Deathbots as affective infrastructures of memory.' The text is primarily black on a white background, with branding logos from 'Memory, Mind & Media' at the top right. The man's hands holding the remote are still visible at the bottom of the frame. (3) Returning to the man in the studio, he continues to narrate, pointing with the remote control to emphasize his points. Large white and yellow text overlays appear in the upper half of the frame, occasionally obscuring the food in the background. His facial expressions are animated, reflecting a storytelling tone. (4) A screenshot of the 'HereAfter AI' web interface is shown, displaying a 'Share Your Story' header above a chat interface with purple message bubbles and sentiment tags like 'Happy' and 'Brave.' The interface is clean and modern. (5) Back to the man in the black shirt, who is now gesturing with both hands as he explains the 'Library Manager' concept. He maintains eye contact with the camera, and his posture is upright and engaged. (6) A screenshot of the 'Seance AI' chat interface appears, showing a conversation with dark-themed UI. A user question about drowning is followed by a long AI response containing several emojis. (7) Returning to the man, he shows a skeptical facial expression while discussing the AI's response. He uses the remote to cycle through points. (8) A mobile interface screenshot shows a chat log with a contact named 'Jen' from October 2024, overlaid on a background photo of people dining. The text blocks are dense and white. (9) The video concludes with the man back in the studio, giving a final summary. He looks slightly to the side and then back to the camera with a wry smile before the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Definition -> Case Study A (Library NPC) -> Case Study B (Generative Ghost) -> Criticism -> Ethical Conclusion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video provides a critical summary of recent research on 'Deathbots' (AI digital afterlife services). It aims to educate the audience on the current technological landscape of digital immortality while highlighting the 'Uncanny Valley' effect and ethical concerns regarding the commercialization of grief and the lack of authentic emotional depth in AI interactions.
